jobs.title: Commercial Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Hello, we're Laka**

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

Raised an awesome Series B investment round

Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK, NL and France, enabling a choice-based, hybrid way of working

Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

Captured the UK, NL and French enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! )

Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

We've also achieved a 5\* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

### **The Commercial Operations Analyst role**

Laka's Commercial team manages partnerships with bike brands, retailers, leasing companies and fleet operators across the UK, France, the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. We have fewer, bigger partners and long sales cycles. So what matters is getting the numbers right: every invoice, every commission statement and every report a partner sees. You'll own that, and build the reporting and processes that help the team grow its accounts.

You'll report to the VP Commercial.

**What you'll be getting up to:**

* Invoice and commission checks
* + Check the partner invoices Finance prepares each month: all of them there, on time, and right against contract terms, including group partners billed across several subsidiaries, entities and currencies (GBP/EUR)
  + Check partner commission statements before they go out, and make sure every partner gets theirs on time
  + Build checks and automation so errors are caught before anything reaches a partner
  + Own the contract register: commission rates, fees, billing entity, renewal and notice dates for every partner
* Reporting and dashboards
* + Build and maintain dashboards in Count (SQL) on partner performance: policies sold, capital acquired, revenue, commission, and trends by market and segment
  + Report account profitability: loss ratio and margin by partner (premium vs claims vs commission vs fulfilment costs), showing which accounts are worth growing and giving evidence for rate reviews and renewals
  + Own the weekly partner reporting with Finance and Data, including how accounts are tagged and mapped
  + Spot what looks off in the numbers and raise it with the account owner
* Partner QBRs
* + Prepare QBR packs for partners: performance, trends and agreed actions
  + Run the QBR calendar so key accounts are reviewed on a regular cadence
* Sales process and deal support
* + Map and tighten the handoffs from signed deal to go-live: contract, pricing set-up, onboarding, first invoice
  + Support deal modelling: commission economics, partner business cases and fee structures
  + Keep HubSpot tidy enough to be useful: accounts, owners, contacts and key dates
* Automation and tools
* + Find manual, repetitive work in the team and automate it (Sheets, Retool, Zapier, AI tools, scripts)
  + Keep templates, playbooks and process docs up to date

  
**Requirements**  

### **This role will be a great fit if you:**

* About you
* + 2 to 5 years in commercial ops, revenue ops, FP&A, business analysis or similar
  + Strong with numbers and data
  + Experience building dashboards in a BI tool (Count, Looker, Metabase, Tableau or similar)
  + Rigorous: you reconcile before you send, and you build checks so the same mistake doesn't happen twice
  + Experience reconciling invoices, commissions or billing data, ideally across entities and currencies
  + Curious about automation and AI, and you've used them to remove manual work
  + Organised and autonomous, happy to build process where little exists, and confident pushing back when it isn't followed
  + Clear communicator with partners and internal teams
* Nice to have
* + Insurance, fintech or B2B2C partnerships
  + French, Dutch or German
  + Python or another scripting language
  + An interest in cycling

  
**Benefits**  

### **Our perks**

What can you expect from working at Laka?

Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London & Bristol (we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

Company bonus scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary in

jobs.title: Commercial Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Hello, we're Laka**

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

Raised an awesome Series B investment round

Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK, NL and France, enabling a choice-based, hybrid way of working

Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

Captured the UK, NL and French enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! )

Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

We've also achieved a 5\* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

### **The Commercial Operations Analyst role**

Laka's Commercial team manages partnerships with bike brands, retailers, leasing companies and fleet operators across the UK, France, the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. We have fewer, bigger partners and long sales cycles. So what matters is getting the numbers right: every invoice, every commission statement and every report a partner sees. You'll own that, and build the reporting and processes that help the team grow its accounts.

You'll report to the VP Commercial.

**What you'll be getting up to:**

* Invoice and commission checks
* + Check the partner invoices Finance prepares each month: all of them there, on time, and right against contract terms, including group partners billed across several subsidiaries, entities and currencies (GBP/EUR)
  + Check partner commission statements before they go out, and make sure every partner gets theirs on time
  + Build checks and automation so errors are caught before anything reaches a partner
  + Own the contract register: commission rates, fees, billing entity, renewal and notice dates for every partner
* Reporting and dashboards
* + Build and maintain dashboards in Count (SQL) on partner performance: policies sold, capital acquired, revenue, commission, and trends by market and segment
  + Report account profitability: loss ratio and margin by partner (premium vs claims vs commission vs fulfilment costs), showing which accounts are worth growing and giving evidence for rate reviews and renewals
  + Own the weekly partner reporting with Finance and Data, including how accounts are tagged and mapped
  + Spot what looks off in the numbers and raise it with the account owner
* Partner QBRs
* + Prepare QBR packs for partners: performance, trends and agreed actions
  + Run the QBR calendar so key accounts are reviewed on a regular cadence
* Sales process and deal support
* + Map and tighten the handoffs from signed deal to go-live: contract, pricing set-up, onboarding, first invoice
  + Support deal modelling: commission economics, partner business cases and fee structures
  + Keep HubSpot tidy enough to be useful: accounts, owners, contacts and key dates
* Automation and tools
* + Find manual, repetitive work in the team and automate it (Sheets, Retool, Zapier, AI tools, scripts)
  + Keep templates, playbooks and process docs up to date

  
**Requirements**  

### **This role will be a great fit if you:**

* About you
* + 2 to 5 years in commercial ops, revenue ops, FP&A, business analysis or similar
  + Strong with numbers and data
  + Experience building dashboards in a BI tool (Count, Looker, Metabase, Tableau or similar)
  + Rigorous: you reconcile before you send, and you build checks so the same mistake doesn't happen twice
  + Experience reconciling invoices, commissions or billing data, ideally across entities and currencies
  + Curious about automation and AI, and you've used them to remove manual work
  + Organised and autonomous, happy to build process where little exists, and confident pushing back when it isn't followed
  + Clear communicator with partners and internal teams
* Nice to have
* + Insurance, fintech or B2B2C partnerships
  + French, Dutch or German
  + Python or another scripting language
  + An interest in cycling

  
**Benefits**  

### **Our perks**

What can you expect from working at Laka?

Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London & Bristol (we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

Company bonus scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary in

Description

Veolia, leader mondial des services à l'environnement, participe chaque jour à construire la sécurité environnementale. Présent sur les cinq continents, le groupe dépollue, décarbone et régénère les ressources à travers des solutions concrètes combinant ses expertises dans le domaine de l'eau, des déchets et de l'énergie.
  
  
Partenaire de nombreux industriels et collectivités, l'Activité Recyclage & Valorisation, entité du groupe Veolia, a pour ambition de devenir le producteur de ressources renouvelables de référence en France. Nous proposons une gamme complète de solutions innovantes à toutes les étapes du cycle des déchets, de leur collecte à leur transformation et valorisation en matière et en énergie, grâce aux étapes de tri et de traitement.

Poste

VOTRE MISSION
  
  
Rattachée à la Direction Direction Services aux Entreprises, au sein de la filière Commerce, Valorisation et Innovation, l'équipe développe de nouvelles offres B2B pour accompagner les entreprises dans leur transition vers l'économie circulaire.
  
  
Acteur de référence de la gestion et de la valorisation des déchets, la DSE évolue dans un marché en pleine transformation, marqué par les évolutions réglementaires, la montée en puissance de l'économie circulaire, la consolidation du secteur et l'évolution des attentes des clients. Pour éclairer ses décisions et soutenir sa conquête de nouvelles parts de marché, l'entreprise crée une équipe Market Intelligence.
  
  
VOS RESPONSABILITÉS :
  
  
Structurer la fonction et manager l'équipe :
  
  

* Définir la vision, le périmètre et la feuille de route; recruter, encadrer et faire monter en compétences les deux analystes;
* Etablir les processus, méthodologies, référentiels et outils de veille et d'analyse;
* Coordonner les demandes des parties prenantes internes.

  
Réaliser des études sectorielles et de marché :
  
  

* Analyser les marchés de la collecte, du tri, du traitement et de la valorisation;
* Etudier les différentes typologies de déchets, filières et zones géographiques;
* Evaluer le potentiel de nouveaux marchés et anticiper les évolutions réglementaires, technologiques et économiques.

  
Déployer une veille stratégique et concurrentielle :
  
  

* Suivre les concurrents, clients et prospects, la réglementation, les technologies, les prix, les appels d'offres et les opérations de fusion-acquisition;
* Diffuser des analyses et alertes directement exploitables par les équipes.

  
Contribuer à la stratégie commerciale de conquête :
  
  

* Identifier et prioriser les cibles, analyser les appels d'offres et les renouvellements de contrats,
* Elaborer des plans de conquête avec les directions commerciales et fournir des analyses de comptes stratégiques.

  
Communiquer et influencer :
  
  

* Présenter les analyses et recommandations à la direction générale et aux comités de direction;
* Adapter les livrables aux besoins des publics et agir comme partenaire stratégique des directions métiers.

Profil

Niveau de formation : Bac +5 (école de commerce, école d'ingénieur ou équivalent)
  
  

* Expérience : 8 à 10 ans en market intelligence, études de marché, conseil en stratégie ou stratégie d'entreprise. Une première expérience en management d'équipe ou en encadrement de projet est indispensable.
* Expertise : maîtrise de l'analyse sectorielle, du dimensionnement de marché et de la veille concurrentielle; capacité à exploiter des sources de données variées.
* Culture commerciale et data : bonne compréhension des enjeux commerciaux B2B, notamment des appels d'offres et des cycles de vente longs; maîtrise d'Excel avancé et d'outils de visualisation tels que Power BI ou équivalent. Des notions de CRM sont appréciées.
* Connaissance sectorielle : une expérience dans les déchets, l'environnement, l'énergie ou les utilities est un atout, mais l'expertise méthodologique prime.
* Qualités personnelles : leadership pragmatique, rigueur intellectuelle, esprit critique, orientation résultats, curiosité, autonomie et capacité à travailler en transversalité avec diplomatie.
* Communication : excellente capacité de synthèse à l'écrit comme à l'oral, avec une réelle aisance pour convaincre.
* Langues : anglais professionnel.

Mot clés: Graphiste, Chargé de communication, Chef de projet

jobs.title: Program Manager III, Supply Chain Operations, Devices and Services
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience in supply chain operations.
* Experience in global operations strategy.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience in data analytics.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

This role drives strategic supply chain and operations initiatives, leading programs independently in ambiguous environments. You will manage cross-functional stakeholders, building scalable processes and systems. Strong communication and presentation skills are essential. You will own and optimize the non-payroll budget as well as headcount metrics, leveraging data for efficiency, and demonstrate expertise in headcount processes. You will independently execute process improvements and partner with Finance to quantify return on investment (ROI) on strategic projects. Managing project schedules and mitigating risks are core responsibilities, ensuring successful delivery of critical initiatives.

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our Devices & Services team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences for users. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make our user's interaction with computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. Whether finding new ways to capture and sense the world around us, advancing form factors, or improving interaction methods, the Devices & Services team is making people's lives better through technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives for supply chain and operations organizations to build scalable processes, tools, capabilities and systems. Includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders.
* Support the logistics and systems organizations in headcount, Opex, business strategy, and more.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Role Summary**

* We are seeking a Business Analyst with hands-on Veeva Vault RIM experience to support our client's Regulatory Affairs technology and process initiatives.
* The role partners with Regulatory Operations, IT, and cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements, define solutions, and support the delivery, enhancement, and adoption of Veeva Vault RIM capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with Regulatory Affairs and Regulatory Operations stakeholders to elicit, document, and validate business requirements for Veeva Vault RIM (Registrations, Submissions, Submissions Archive, Publishing, Submissions Content Plans)
* Translate business needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and use cases
* Perform gap/fit analysis and recommend configuration vs. customization options within Vault RIM
* Work closely with technical teams, Veeva consultants, and system integrators to support configuration, enhancements, and releases
* Support Veeva's quarterly/general release cycles, including impact assessment, regression and user acceptance testing (UAT), and release communications
* Develop test scenarios and scripts, coordinate UAT, and track defects through resolution
* Support data migration, data mapping, and data quality activities related to RIM initiatives
* Assist with integrations between Vault RIM and other systems (e.g., Vault QualityDocs, Vault Safety, document management, publishing tools, Master Data/IDMP-related sources)
* Create and maintain documentation including SOPs, work instructions, training materials, and validation deliverables in line with GxP and CSV requirements
* Provide end-user support, training, and change management assistance to drive adoption
* Track project status, risks, and issues; communicate progress to stakeholders
* Contribute to continuous improvement of regulatory processes and system capabilities

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field
* 6–8 years of experience as a Business Analyst, with at least 3+ years in the life sciences / pharma / biotech industry
* Hands-on experience with Veeva Vault RIM (Registrations, Submissions, Submissions Publishing, or Archive modules)
* Strong understanding of Regulatory Affairs processes, including global submissions, health authority commitments, and product registration lifecycle
* Experience writing user stories, BRDs/FRDs, and process maps
* Experience with UAT planning and execution in a validated (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11) environment
* Familiarity with SDLC and Agile/Scrum or hybrid delivery methodologies
* Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Veeva Vault RIM certification or Vault Administrator certification
* Experience with eCTD, regulatory publishing tools, and health authority submission standards
* Exposure to IDMP / SPOR, RIM data migration, or legacy system decommissioning
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, or Azure DevOps
* Knowledge of other Veeva Vault applications (QMS, QualityDocs, PromoMats, Clinical)
* Prior experience with large pharma or biotech clients

**Core Competencies**

* Analytical and problem-solving mindset
* Strong documentation skills
* Collaboration across business and technical teams
* Attention to detail and compliance focus
* Adaptability and ownership

Pay: $50.00 - $70.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Foster City, CA 94404

jobs.title: Operations Data Analyst, Expert
jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 175204
  
  
**Job Category:** Business Operations / Strategy
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Energy Delivery
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Oakland
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Operations Data Analyst extracts operations data for analysis, leadership support, and responses to ad hoc data requests. The incumbent maintains operations tools and databases, ensuring that they are kept up to date using data from various PG&E systems. He/she develops, maintains, and enhances operational metric database tools for the broader analytics team(s). The Analyst identifies and solves current gaps in data requirements and ease of access to ensure fast and consistent responses to leadership inquiries. PROJECT MANAGEMENT: Manages data management projects from initial request to presentation of data results, ensuring that the project is completed within budget and on time. DATA PROCESSING: Creates automated data routines and processes for reporting and delivery, ensuring accurate data manipulation and cleansing. DATA EXTRACTS AND FILE TRANSFERS: Manages extracting data and transferring data from databases to various analysts to support operational analysis efforts. DATA ANALYSIS: Analyzes data using various statistical tools to develop ad hoc reports, statistics, trends, and profiles. REPORTING: Develops and communicates clear, concise, and actionable data analysis for clients.
  
  
PG&E is providing the salary range that the company, in good faith, believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, particular skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, collective bargaining agreements, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range ($120,000 - $160,000), the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to these factors . This job can also include participation in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.
  
**A reasonable salary range is:** ​ Bay Area Minimum: $126,000 Bay Area Mid-Point: $163,000 Bay Area Maximum: $200,000
  
**&/OR​ California Minimum:** $120,000 California Mid-Point: $155,000 California Maximum: $190,000
  
  
**Responsibilities:** Manages complex data analysis projects with limited supervision on only the most complicated projects, from initial requests to presenting data results, ensuring the project is completed within budget and on time. Designs data analysis to achieve business objectives, processes data, analyzes data, writes clear and concise data findings, and tailors communications to specific audiences. Creates automated data routines and processes for reporting and data delivery, ensuring accurate data manipulation and cleansing. Manages very complex data extracts and list pulls, ensuring data accuracy. Manages data extraction and transfers the data from databases to various analysts to support operational analysis efforts. Analyzes data using advanced statistical tools to develop complex ad hoc reports, statistics, trends, and profiles. Demonstrates and utilizes broad expertise in data processing and analysis and applies this knowledge to several different issues. Provides new and innovative solutions and recommendations to enhance database(s) with new data sources and improved data processes. Develops comprehensive reports and communicates clear, concise, and actionable data analyses for clients. Prepares and develops presentation materials including data analytics results, visualization and recommendations. Acts as team lead and provides directions to less experienced employees. Works with Directors and Managers across functions to influence decisions.
  
  
Qualifications
  
**Minimum:** BA/BS Degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or other related field or equivalent work experience Six years of related work experience
  
**Desired:** Master’s degree Advanced project management skills to lead cross-functional teams. Advanced skill in Microsoft Power BI (report, visuals, dashboard). Strong knowledge of Palantir Foundry tools and data architecture. Strong organizational, prioritization, and multi-tasking skills. Influence skills. Strong problem-solving skills. Strong knowledge of Python (numpy, matplotlib, pandas, geopandas, pyspark). Advanced skill in Microsoft Excel (complex formulas, graphing, VBA). Advanced skill in writing SQL queries using Oracle or Business Objects. Familiarity with utility operations.

new_jobs.title: Talent Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**A World-Changing Company**

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Talent Program Manager to join a cross-functional group of operators and specialists who are responsible for executing on people initiatives that support Palantir's talented employees, work, and values. Our mandate is broad, and you'll work on projects that span People Experience operational responsibilities as well as internal events, new hire onboarding, and logistics support.
  
  
As a Talent Program Manager, you’ll work with other program managers to support initiatives across People Experience, Events, and Learning. You’ll host Indoc, our new-hire program, in London about every other week and partner with company leaders to improve the program and showcase great work across the business. You’ll also help keep key People Experience projects on track by improving processes, clearing roadblocks, and anticipating what stakeholders need. This role suits someone who enjoys solving problems, bringing structure to ambiguity, and learning from good ideas, wherever they come from. The team and its work are still evolving, so flexibility and a willingness to pick up new skills are important.

### **Core Responsibilities**

* Facilitate new hire onboarding in-person in our London office every other week (on average)
* Own operational workflows across the People Experience team, spanning new hire onboarding, learning programs, and internal events both on and offsite
* Work directly with external stakeholders, as well as internal teams (e.g. Finance, Procurement, Legal, Information Security, etc.) to coordinate the full life cycle for event logistics, contracts, and payments
* Leverage new product and artificial intelligence to scale team’s operational reach

### **What We Value**

* Comfortable facilitating large events, with the ability to command a room of 20-200+ attendees
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse teams and stakeholders while building positive working relationships
* Strong organization and problem-solving skills. You should be able to anticipate challenges and complications, multitask in a rapidly-changing environment, and use good judgement in making appropriate tradeoffs when executing on competing priorities.
* A creative approach to project management centered around lightweight frameworks that enable rapid iteration and low-overhead methods of keeping our partnering teams informed
* Strong attention to detail, including maintaining accurate records and diligently tracking key project metrics and reporting

### **What We Require**

* 2+ years experience in an operational role, preferably in a fast-paced or dynamic environment
* Ability and willingness to be onsite 5 days per week

**Life at Palantir**

We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.

In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.

If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process*,* please reach out and let us know how we can help.

*Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US* *FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3)**.*

**Contract: Healthcare**

**Location: Reading****, RG30 4EJ (Prospect Park Hospital)**

**Hours of work: 37.5**

**Contract Type: Permanent**

  

We are seeking a Project Manager - Healthcare to help deliver safe, consistent and commercially controlled project outcomes across healthcare sites.

  

This role will manage lifecycle, variation, small works, infrastructure and capital projects from initial brief through design, procurement, construction, commissioning, handover and post-project review.

**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced project professional with a strong background in Hard FM, building services, engineering, construction or estates environments.

  

Operating within live and operationally critical clinical settings, you will ensure project decisions support patient safety, clinical continuity, compliance, resilience of critical engineering systems and effective asset management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply project governance, stage-gate controls, delegated authorities and approval processes across all assigned projects.
* Maintain accurate project records including programme, cost, forecast, risk, actions, change control and delivery status within Monday.com.
* Manage projects through applicable RIBA stages, from feasibility and design through to commissioning, handover and post-occupancy review.
* Coordinate design reviews and stakeholder engagement with Hard FM teams, Estates, clinical users, contractors and specialist advisers.
* Plan and manage permits, isolations, shutdowns, phasing, access arrangements and infection prevention measures to minimise disruption to clinical services.
* Maintain effective commercial control, including budgets, forecasts, variations, cash flow, invoicing and final account management.
* Ensure asset information, commissioning documentation, certificates, drawings, warranties and maintenance information are accurately handed over and reflected within CAFM systems.
* Act as the primary site interface for project stakeholders, building trusted relationships and driving continuous improvement through lessons learned.

**Professional and Personal Competencies/Qualifications**

* Demonstrable project management experience within building services, engineering, construction, estates or Hard FM environments.
* Experience delivering projects within occupied and operationally sensitive environments.
* PFI experience is essential, with healthcare sector experience strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of CDM Regulations 2015, project health and safety, programme management, risk management, change control and contractor management.
* Practical understanding of NHS estates requirements, including HTMs, HBNs, infection prevention and control, critical engineering resilience and live clinical project constraints.
* Experience delivering projects aligned to RIBA stages.
    
  Knowledge of lifecycle planning, SAMP or LAMP environments, CAFM systems and structured asset handback processes.
* Strong commercial acumen covering budgets, forecasting, variations, contract administration, procurement and supply chain management.
* Ability to identify, manage and escalate safety, compliance, operational and commercial risks appropriately.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across client, operational and technical teams.

**The Company**

ISS is a world-leading workplace and facility management company, connecting people and places to make the world work better. Working with customers day by day, side by side, we understand every aspect of the user experience.
  
  
Through a unique combination of intelligent solutions, high standards and people who care, to help our customers achieve their purpose, whether it’s hospitals healing patients, businesses producing the next great innovation, or airports bringing passengers home to their families. ISS is committed to doing business the right way, taking its corporate responsibility very seriously. Our passion is people.
  
  
We offer you a challenging and exciting career in an organisation with people at its heart. In ISS, everyone has the opportunity to develop, grow and make a difference. #Becomewhoyouwant, #Bepartofsomethingbigger,

#aplacetobeyou,

#facilitiesmanagement

  

ISS is proud to be a diverse and inclusive employer.
  
  
ISS welcomes all applicants regardless of age, disability, gender identity or gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race (which includes race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin and caste), religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or educational background.
  
  
We are proud to be a Gold Employer Recognition Scheme (ERS) award holder and a signatory of the Armed Forces Covenant, recognising our commitment to supporting veterans, reservists, and military families. Through our Joint Forces Programme, we provide mentoring and support to members of the Armed Forces community and their spouses as they transition into civilian careers.
  
  
We are a Disability Confident Committed (Level 2) employer, proudly supporting and promoting inclusive hiring practices in line with the UK government’s Disability Confident scheme.
  
  
Our passion for inclusivity and diversity makes ISS a more creative, productive and happy place to work.
  
  
If you have any further queries regarding this role, please contact the Resourcing Team by emailing resourcing.team@uk.issworld.com

  
  
  

To find out more about what we do go here - https://www.uk.issworld.com/

new_jobs.title: Acquisition Security Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**MANTECH seeks** a motivated, career and customer-oriented **Acquisition Security Analyst II** to join our team in **El Segundo, CA**.

This role supports the Government Program Manager with the development and implementation of comprehensive program protection methodologies to protect advanced technology programs throughout the system’s lifecycle. This is a full-time, five-day-a-week in-office position in El Segundo, CA.

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Perform in-depth lifecycle program analysis to identify Critical Program Information (CPI), Critical System Resources (CSR), and associated vulnerabilities.
* Develop, execute, and implement risk management-based Program Protection Plans (PPP) and security countermeasures.
* Provide technical advice and security support to collateral, Special Access Programs (SAP), and emerging mission areas.
* Deliver security guidance on contract requirements, cost feasibility, and standardized DD Form 254 processes throughout acquisition and sustainment lifecycles.
* Develop, write, and review key security documentation including OPSEC plans, Security Classification Guides (SCG), Exposure Contingency Plans (ECP), and Security Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Assess foreign intelligence threats against critical research and prepare analytical products to guide security policy and classification decisions.
* Coordinate across Air Force security authorities and Mission Partners while delivering security education and support for system close-out actions.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related area or an additional 4 years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
* 10+ years of related acquisition program experience, including at least 6 years supporting SCI or SAR programs.
* Strong familiarity with security policies, manuals, and guiding documents, including applicable ICDs, JAFANs, and DoD Manuals.
* Extensive knowledge of DD Form 254 implementation within the Air Force acquisition lifecycle.
* Proven experience conducting risk assessments, developing OPSEC plans, and providing detailed security classification guidance.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic environment while effectively interacting with DoD, military, civilian, and industry partners.
* High degree of originality, creativity, and initiative while working effectively with minimal supervision.

**Clearance Requirements:**

* Current Top-Secret Clearance with SCI Eligibility.
* Willingness to submit a polygraph.
* Eligibility for access to Special Access Program Information.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time in closed-area office settings.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the Program’s Area of Responsibility (AOR) via air and ground transportation.
